title: Monetary Penalty on Bank of Baroda
description: <cite index="10-9,10-10">Bank of Baroda was fined Rs. 63.6 lakh for non-compliance with provisions of the Fair Practices Code for Lenders and Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines</cite>. <cite index="10-12,10-13">The regulator found that the bank had charged interest above the contracted rate in certain loan accounts and failed to upload KYC records of some customers to the Central KYC Records Registry within the prescribed timeline</cite>.
